name: On The Rocks
source:
Play as Shu, an amateur photographer leaving his boring everyday life behind for a shot of excitement. Explore the Nightdweller’s city, full of odd and exciting encounters; each mixing in a new kick to your bland cocktail. With four unique love interests to choose from, will Shu ever find the perfect mix of a new life he’s been looking for?

[From [url=https://captncorazn.itch.io/on-the-rocks]itch.io[/url]]
